evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion without addressing an audience or invoking authority.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Logical contrast (commodity vs asset) carries rational-persuasion; the valorising of perspective as what one keeps adds an inspirational-appeal to values.

mints.name: CommodityVersusAssetContrast
mints.title: the substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority by partitioning value into what is disposable versus what one retains, rather than by rank or evidence?
